native_rule.creator: bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.description: Detects FortiGate system update events that indicate a configuration change, while excluding routine AV database reload activity. Unauthorized firewall configuration updates may modify security policies or other firewall settings, potentially weakening security controls, exposing internal resources, or enabling unauthorized network access.
native_rule.name: [Nopalcyber][AI SIEM] FortiGate Firewall Configuration Update

scheduledParams.query:
dataSource.name='FortiGate'
event.type = 'system' 
unmapped.action = 'update' 
unmapped.logdesc != 'Scanunit reloaded AV Database' 
| group count() by unmapped.logdesc

native_rule.scopeName: Nopal Support Services Pvt. Ltd., / NopalCyber
native_rule.statusReason: Rule was activated by bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com and will become Active within an hour
